title: Family Church Students — Announcements

items.title: Wednesday Night
details: Hangout at 6:00, service about 6:30, pickup through 8:15.

items.title: Upward Basketball (6th–8th grade)
details: Player evaluations Nov 3 or Nov 5. First practice Dec 7. First games Jan 8 and 9. Ask your parents to register.

items.title: Student Friendsgiving
details: Dessert night (students bring desserts). Takes the place of regular Wednesday. Bring a friend — guests don't need to bring anything. Short message, then high school open gym after middle school pickup at 8:00.

items.title: Christmas Party
details: Big invite night. All students (middle and high school) combined. Details still being finalized.
